cross_cutting_findings.title: Boot-critical hardcoded protected-folder workbook
cross_cutting_findings.detail: tkp_ts.py:244 hardcodes the workbook path; lines 379-387 and 444-452 call sys.exit(1) if it is missing or unreadable. No env override exists on live-main. TKP cannot start on the VPS without either merging the path-portability branch or supplying the file.

Earlier branches and some docs/migration files still say E:\H&C and are superseded.

cross_cutting_findings.title: openpyxl and dash-bootstrap-components missing from requirements.txt
cross_cutting_findings.detail: A clean pip install -r requirements.txt produces an environment where all three apps fail at import.

cross_cutting_findings.title: AGM runs on default credentials
cross_cutting_findings.detail: reboot_mp_ts.ps1 loads only .local_dev.env, so AGM_ADMIN_TOKEN and AGM_SESSION_SECRET fall back to the non-secret development defaults in tcp_config.py. .gitignore already anticipates a .agm_production.env that was never created.

cross_cutting_findings.title: Production ingest configuration lives in a file named .local_dev.env
cross_cutting_findings.detail: All three production launchers load it. It sets GLENN_UPLOADER_INGEST_ENABLED=true, the shared ingest token, and TEARSHEET_LOCAL_DIRECT_ADMIN=1. Split it on the VPS; do not set the direct-admin flag on a server.

cross_cutting_findings.title: Non-atomic state writes
cross_cutting_findings.detail: TKP and AGM write their authoritative JSON with a plain open(path, 'w') - no lock, no temp-and-rename, no backup. A restart mid-write can truncate state. This also makes running a staff process concurrently with the public process a last-writer-wins hazard. TCP is safe: lock plus temp plus os.replace plus backup rotation.

cross_cutting_findings.title: No benchmark cache and no skip flag
cross_cutting_findings.detail: TKP downloads benchmarks via quantstats and yfinance on every boot with no cache file and no cache-only flag. TCP has TCP_V2_SKIP_BENCHMARK_FETCH and AGM has AGM_BENCHMARK_CACHE_ONLY; TKP has neither.

cross_cutting_findings.title: No crash auto-restart today and interactive logon required
cross_cutting_findings.detail: Startup runs from the user Startup folder via Manager\launch_all_services.py, which does not supervise or restart these services. NSSM fixes both weaknesses.

cross_cutting_findings.title: Root-level algominds modules reach into the Momentum Pacer data tree
cross_cutting_findings.detail: algominds_daily_balances.py and algominds_benchmark_daily.py sit at the worktree root and build paths as Path(__file__).parent / 'Momentum Pacer' / 'data' / ... The directory relationship must be preserved exactly or those paths break.

cross_cutting_findings.title: Row-count discrepancy to resolve before reconciliation
cross_cutting_findings.detail: daily_returns_secret_state.json holds 896 records while /healthz reports rows_loaded: 766. The two come from different sources (full persisted editor table vs the Excel-derived NAV frame bounded by FORCE_LAST_EXCEL_ROW = 715). Explain this before using row count as a VPS-vs-laptop check for TKP.

cross_cutting_findings.title: Staff ports are not required for migration
cross_cutting_findings.detail: Ports 8321, 8322, and 8324 have no listener, and Manager\startup_contract.json classifies all three as manual only. Every write path is registered on the same Flask app that serves the public port, so the daily update flow does not need them.
